name: The Crew
description: The sources of the Kodi add-on The Crew that still work, ported: torrents from Torrentio and Knaben for Play, Search and Find releases, played as direct streams through Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize or TorBox when you have an account.

listing.summary: Torrents from Torrentio and Knaben, and direct play through your debrid account (Real-Debrid, AllDebrid, Premiumize, TorBox).
listing.description: A port of the Kodi add-on The Crew (GPL-3.0) to a Playpex plugin: its scrapers that still answer and give something Playpex plays. Torrentio (many torrent sites, by IMDb id: the exact file of an episode, also inside season packs) and Knaben (a search across torrent sites, with live seed counts). With a debrid account, a torrent the service already has plays at once as a direct stream: Premiumize and TorBox say which ones they have ("Cached on"), Real-Debrid and AllDebrid are tried first when you pick one (they no longer tell), the torrent plays otherwise. Its catalog, lists and Trakt are Playpex's own; its file-host sites, its Cloudflare-blocked sites and its adult sites are left out.
listing.disclaimer: Streaming copyrighted content may be illegal where you live. Educational project. The scrapers' logic comes from The Crew (GPL-3.0).

settings.label: Torrentio
settings.description: Torrents of a title from many torrent sites, found by its IMDb id: an episode's own file, also inside season packs. In Play.

settings.label: Knaben
settings.description: A search across torrent sites, with live seed counts. In Play, Search and Find releases.

settings.label: Real-Debrid API token
settings.description: From real-debrid.com/apitoken. Real-Debrid no longer says what it has: a torrent you pick is asked for there first.

settings.label: AllDebrid API key
settings.description: From alldebrid.com/apikeys. Like Real-Debrid, it's asked first when you pick a torrent.

settings.label: Premiumize API key
settings.description: From premiumize.me/account. The torrents it has show "Cached on Premiumize" and play at once.

settings.label: TorBox API key
settings.description: From torbox.app/settings. The torrents it has show "Cached on TorBox" and play at once.
